envh-09-c2.quote: To save money, officials decided to switch the municipal water source from Lake Huron to the Flint River on April 25th, 2014.
envh-09-c2.claim: In April 2014, the city of Flint, Michigan, under a state-appointed emergency manager, switched its water supply from Detroit's Lake Huron source to the Flint River to save money.
